cheng: Heads-up — queue depth spike in eu-west-2 for aurora-7b and aurora-13b.
cheng: Per-model backlog right now: aurora-7b = 520 requests, aurora-13b = 180 requests. Avg wait ~6.2s, 95p tail ~23s. Seeing a bunch of retrain-prod-2026-03 prefix traffic.
cheng: Sample tail of the scheduler log:```
2026-03-17T11:02:13Z scheduler[euw2]: enq model=aurora-7b id=... backlog=512
2026-03-17T11:04:01Z scheduler[euw2]: admit_try model=aurora-7b took=0.02s q_len=498
2026-03-17T11:05:33Z scheduler[euw2]: backpressured model=aurora-13b reason=capacity shard=3
```
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert created: queue_depth_high (eu-west-2) — <https://monitoring.redwood/team/queues|monitoring link>
alex: Oncall — can we spin up additional capacity or is autoscaler at limit?
marta: Autoscaler is at ~92% (maintenance window: 4 hosts drained in euw2-hostpool). There are 8 spare preemptible GPUs but they're blocked by netpolicy changes from yesterday; infra has a ticket open (INFRA-1234). Adding hosts will be slow — estimate 12–20 minutes for new nodes to be provisioned.
samir: Short-term mitigation: soft-throttle non-critical tenants + tighten admission control for aurora-7b. Suggest: reduce concurrency to 2 and lower burst to 4 for experimental orgs, and set token-bucket rate to 60 rps/shard.
samir: Quick admin API (run as infra-admin):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://api.redwood.internal/adm/admission/aurora-7b" -d '{"concurrency":2, "burst":4, "rate_rps":60, "match":"org:experimental*"}'
```
cheng: Sounds good — apply only to experimental tenants and retrain-prod prefix. Also add a fallback route for best-effort calls to aurora-4b-quant (lower cost) so critical user flows aren't affected. Route name: `fallback-euw2-aurora-experimental`.
alex: I'll run the throttle patch and watch the dashboards. If latency for critical customers increases, I'll revert in 5m. :ok_hand:
alex: PATCH succeeded — admin API return: 200 OK. Watching <https://dashboards.redwood/team/queues?region=euw2>.
marta: Creating a short-lived eviction canary for retrain-prod-2026-03 to expire tasks >30m. If backlog doesn't drop by 12:10 UTC escalate to SRE pager. Ticket INFRA-1234 updated.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll join if escalation occurs. Please add `incident.queue.euw2` tag to the ticket and update the runbook steps (section: temporary admission rules).
cheng: Thanks — will follow up with a short postmortem if this becomes recurring pattern.
